panama_HR_27:
"Goal/Purpose": "Regulate and operationalize the Climate Risk Observatory at the national level and establish, pilot, scale up, and consolidate a territorial network of observatories/units and early meteorological warning systems to strengthen climate-risk management, territorial planning, resilience, vulnerability reporting, adaptation project support, and integration with the national monitoring and evaluation system.",
"Action/Intervention": "Define the Observatory architecture, including components, tools, dashboards, data standards, institutional roles, access rules, updating protocols, and the official set of adaptation, loss, and damage indicators; design the operational model with minimum services, protocols for accompanying local governments, criteria for territorial prioritization, and a standard package of tools; constitute the Community Resilience Technical Team and define coordination with universities, CSOs, municipalities, and community councils; formalize territorial alliances through framework agreements for hosting and operating observatories; design the territorial Network of Early Meteorological Warning Systems with IMHPA and SINAPROC, including priority municipalities/watersheds, activation and response protocols, communication channels, and interoperability and coverage requirements; agree with ASEP and mobile-telephony operators on interoperability and mass-diffusion of warnings; implement pilot observatories in prioritized regions; operate early-warning systems in pilot territories with simulation exercises, community-communication protocols, and feedback mechanisms; integrate climate analysis into territorial planning and local investment prioritization; systematize and report territorial information using standardized formats and delivery pathways to feed the Climate Risk Observatory and national M&E system; adjust the model based on pilot evaluation; scale up the observatory network to new regions; consolidate a continuous territorial capacity-strengthening program with standardized curricula and alliances with universities/NGOs; strengthen technical and operational interoperability between territorial observatories and the Climate Risk Observatory; integrate the territorial network into planning and financing mechanisms; ensure the verifiable operation of at least 10 observatories/units with minimum standards.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate risk management, adaptation, loss and damage, territorial planning, municipal/watershed early warning systems, resilience and vulnerability monitoring, national and territorial observatory systems, and nature-based solutions.",
"Target Audience": "National-level institutions responsible for the Climate Risk Observatory; IMHPA; SINAPROC; ASEP; mobile-telephony operators; local governments; municipalities; community councils; universities; CSOs/NGOs; local actors hosting observatories; prioritized territories/regions; and communities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A nationally regulated and operational Climate Risk Observatory with defined architecture, standards, roles, and indicators; an operational model for territorial observatories and support services; a constituted Community Resilience Technical Team; formalized territorial alliances for observatory hosting and operation; operational municipal/watershed early warning systems with interoperability and mass-diffusion mechanisms; pilot observatories and pilot early-warning systems functioning in prioritized territories; climate risk integrated into district plans and local investment prioritization; standardized territorial reporting feeding the national Observatory and M&E system with periodic quality verification; a pilot-tested and adjusted model for 2031-2033 scale-up; expanded observatory coverage in more vulnerable territories with methodological consistency; continuous territorial capacity strengthening; improved interoperability and automated data flows for national decision-making and financing; integration of observatory support and reporting into planning and financing mechanisms; and verifiable operation of at least 10 observatories/units meeting minimum standards."
panama_HR_28:
"Goal/Purpose": "Formalize and operationalize the financial architecture of the Nature Pledge by defining the roles, governance, eligibility criteria, and alignment of the Fondo Panamá Natural, the Fondo Reforesta, and other financial vehicles with climate, biodiversity, and land targets; strengthen institutional and financial management capacities; establish coordinated capitalization and governance arrangements; and ensure transparent, stable, multi-source financing for prioritized conservation, restoration, adaptation, and mitigation actions.",
"Action/Intervention": "Define the specific role of the Fondo Panamá Natural, the Fondo Reforesta, and other financial vehicles, including their governance mechanisms, eligibility criteria, and alignment with climate, biodiversity, and land targets; strengthen institutional capacities for trust fund management, capital mobilization, and financial administration; review and update the operating regulations of the Fondo Reforesta to simplify processes, clarify roles, update eligibility requirements, reduce procedures, and establish maximum evaluation and disbursement timeframes; approve the final version of the Conservation and Community Development Plan of the Fondo Panamá Natural; develop a national portfolio of reforestation, restoration, and agroforestry projects aligned with priority regions, degraded areas, and implementing actors, and coherent with the Conservation and Community Development Plan; design and approve the governance model of the Fondo Panamá Natural, including institutional roles, participation mechanisms, administrative processes, and coordination guidelines with the Fondo Reforesta; prepare and formalize the legal agreement of the Fondo Panamá Natural establishing obligations, closing conditions, long-term financial commitments, and provisions for long-term stability; establish a permanent technical team to support project formulation, follow-up, and evaluation under the Fondo Reforesta and strengthen capacities of implementing actors in territory; align existing fiscal and financial incentives with the Nature Pledge architecture in coordination with the incentives reform of Target 14; establish social, environmental, and gender safeguards; capitalize and put into full operation the Fondo Panamá Natural and the Fondo Reforesta with stable financial flows from public, private, and international cooperation sources; mobilize at least USD 300 million toward prioritized actions; implement innovative financing mechanisms including PES, biodiversity credits, and carbon markets with associated monitoring, reporting, and verification systems; and publish periodic reports on financing and impacts to ensure transparency and accountability.",

"Target Audience": "Fondo Panamá Natural, Fondo Reforesta, other financial vehicles under the Nature Pledge, institutions responsible for trust fund management and financial administration, implementing actors in territory, local communities, indigenous peoples, vulnerable groups, investors, civil society, and public, private, and international cooperation financing sources.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "A formalized and coordinated financial architecture for the Nature Pledge; updated and simplified operating regulations for the Fondo Reforesta; an approved Conservation and Community Development Plan for the Fondo Panamá Natural; an approved governance model and legal agreement for the Fondo Panamá Natural; a national portfolio of reforestation, restoration, and agroforestry projects aligned with priority regions and degraded areas; a permanent technical team supporting project formulation, follow-up, and evaluation; aligned fiscal and financial incentives; established social, environmental, and gender safeguards; the capitalization and full operation of the Fondo Panamá Natural and the Fondo Reforesta with stable multi-source financial flows; mobilization of at least USD 300 million toward prioritized actions; implementation of PES, biodiversity credits, and carbon markets with monitoring, reporting, and verification systems; and periodic financing and impact reports that guarantee transparency, accountability, and trust."
panama_HR_29:
"Goal/Purpose": "To harmonize implementation of the Escazú Agreement with the Nature Pledge governance framework; design and implement a national mechanism for the protection of environmental defenders; integrate access to environmental information, public participation, and environmental justice into Nature Pledge implementation; incorporate equitable representation and a gender approach into decision-making spaces; and consolidate local capacities for conflict prevention and mediation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Harmonize the national Roadmap for implementation of the Escazú Agreement with the Nature Pledge governance framework defined in Target 30, identifying institutional responsibilities, articulation points, and operational gaps; design the national mechanism for the protection of environmental defenders, defining institutional architecture, complaint pathways, activation criteria, protection measures, and inter-institutional coordination, based on Article 9 of the Escazú Agreement and current national regulations; integrate the principles of access to environmental information of the Escazú Agreement into national information and monitoring systems, ensuring operational coherence with Target 25 and the roles of ANTAI as the transparency-guarantor entity; develop operational protocols to guarantee effective public participation and access to environmental justice in implementation of Nature Pledge targets, prioritizing territories with high socio-environmental conflict; define indicators of access to information, effective participation, protection of defenders, and gender equity, aligned with the national system for monitoring adaptation, loss, and damage; implement the national mechanism for the protection of environmental defenders in prioritized territories and articulate it with the community resilience observatories defined in Target 27; implement territorial mechanisms for access to information, participation, and environmental justice through public environmental-information platforms, territorial outreach and participation events, and technical and legal accompaniment schemes for communities and vulnerable groups in prioritized territories; incorporate mandatory criteria of equitable representation and a gender approach into regulations, terms of reference, and designation mechanisms of Nature Pledge decision-making spaces, and apply these criteria at national and territorial levels; consolidate local capacities for mediation, community accompaniment, and preventive management of conflicts linked to implementation of environmental projects.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Environmental governance, access to environmental information, public participation, environmental justice, protection of environmental defenders, transparency, gender equity, territorial implementation in prioritized territories, and conflict management linked to environmental projects.",
"Target Audience": "Institutions responsible for implementing the Escazú Agreement and the Nature Pledge governance framework; ANTAI; Nature Pledge decision-making spaces at national and territorial levels; environmental defenders; communities and vulnerable groups in prioritized territories; and local actors involved in mediation, accompaniment, and conflict prevention.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Institutional responsibilities, articulation points, and operational gaps identified; a national mechanism for the protection of environmental defenders designed and implemented; access to environmental information principles integrated into national information and monitoring systems; operational protocols for effective public participation and access to environmental justice developed; indicators on access to information, participation, protection of defenders, and gender equity defined; territorial mechanisms for information, participation, and justice implemented in prioritized territories; equitable representation and gender approach incorporated into decision-making regulations and composition; and strengthened local capacities for mediation, community accompaniment, and preventive conflict management."

panama_PNSH_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure that every person in this country has sustained access to quality water and basic sanitation, sufficiently safe to lead a dignified, clean, healthy, and productive life.",
"Action/Intervention": "Progressively expand the coverage of water and sanitation services at the national level and eliminate inequalities in access in an inclusive and equitable manner, in accordance with users' needs.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water and sanitation services at the national level.",
"Target Audience": "Every person in this country; users of water and sanitation services.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Universal access to quality water and sanitation services, with expanded national coverage and elimination of inequalities in access."
panama_PNSH_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase coverage of drinking water services by expanding water supply coverage at the urban and rural levels in communities where service is deficient.",
"Action/Intervention": "Carry out studies and corresponding designs, and construct and/or expand new infrastructure to meet new demand, including 136 construction and/or expansion projects for new treatment plants, rural water systems, wells, water systems, conveyance lines, and supply systems between 2015 and 2020.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Drinking water supply services in urban, rural, peri-urban, and indigenous areas.",
"Target Audience": "Communities where drinking water service is deficient, including urban, rural, peri-urban, and indigenous populations, particularly communities with more than 10,000 inhabitants such as Besiko, Ñurum, La Palma, and Chichica.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "By 2020, drinking water supply coverage reaches 98% of the urban population and 70% of rural and indigenous areas."
panama_PNSH_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "To provide all households with basic sanitation conditions.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improving sanitary sewer systems in cities, eliminating latrines across the country, expanding the existing sanitary sewer network, and constructing treatment plants and sanitary sewers.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Sanitation services and urban sanitary sewer systems.",
"Target Audience": "All households across the country.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased sanitation services and basic sanitation conditions for all households, with latrines eliminated across the country and expanded sanitary sewer coverage."
panama_PNSH_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Planning for water and sanitation systems at the national level and supporting the sustainability of investments in water and sanitation improvements.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct studies, research, and pilot projects to evaluate the behavior of supply, demand, and water-supply efficiency; develop 12 projects classified into water and sanitation studies and water and sanitation plans.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water and sanitation systems at the national level.",
"Target Audience": "National-level water and sanitation sector stakeholders involved in planning and investment in water and sanitation improvements.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Evaluation of supply, demand, and water-supply efficiency, and development of 12 projects under water and sanitation studies and water and sanitation plans."
panama_PNSH_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Provide an important basis for decision-making and ensure efficient management of water resources to meet the needs of various uses for inclusive socio-economic growth.",
"Action/Intervention": "Have basic information about water, such as the amount of water available in watersheds, projected demands, and ecosystem needs.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources in watersheds.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers and users across human consumption, agriculture, industry, energy, transport, tourism, and biodiversity.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved decision-making and efficient management of water resources to meet the needs of various uses."
panama_PNSH_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Management of water-resource availability.",
"Action/Intervention": "Permanent execution of projects, including investments for new studies and to improve water-resource monitoring capabilities: studies of water balances of surface sources; National Water Resources Information System; hydrometeorological monitoring; estimation of environmental flows.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved water-resource monitoring capabilities; new studies on water balances of surface sources; implementation or strengthening of the National Water Resources Information System; hydrometeorological monitoring; estimation of environmental flows."
panama_PNSH_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "To organize freshwater use and consumption, make demand more efficient through technological tools, and monitor compliance.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organizing user demand; incorporating technological tools that improve demand efficiency; monitoring compliance; carrying out studies for the use of treated wastewater in cities; implementing projects for the use of treated wastewater in cities; improving irrigation system technology; developing new options for reserving water; implementing 24 projects in the thematic areas of organization of user demand, adoption of new technologies and more efficient water-use systems, and improvements to irrigation distribution systems.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Freshwater demand management, urban water use, and irrigation systems.",
"Target Audience": "Water users, cities, and irrigation systems.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "More efficient water use and consumption, monitored compliance, use of treated wastewater in cities, improved irrigation technology and distribution systems, and new options for reserving water."
panama_PNSH_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the availability of freshwater by increasing water-resource availability capacity to meet current and future needs for drinking water consumption, food production, energy generation, industry, transport, recreation, ecosystems, new uses, and urban growth, while preventing future shortages caused by the effects of an unpredictable climate.",
"Action/Intervention": "Carry out studies and research to evaluate and demonstrate the feasibility of increasing water availability; construct infrastructure to conserve water, including multipurpose reservoirs and accelerated rainwater harvesting in the metropolitan area and provincial capitals; convert reservoirs currently used exclusively for energy into multipurpose reservoirs; establish multipurpose reservoirs in the Indio, Santa María, La Villa, Perales, Parita, Oria, and Ocú rivers; implement rainwater harvesting projects; initiate social, environmental, and economic studies and technical designs for a Bayano water treatment plant; undertake rainwater harvesting, cloud seeding, and water reserves for agriculture.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Freshwater and water-resource management; metropolitan area and provincial capitals; eastern sector of the province of Panama; the Indio, Santa María, La Villa, Perales, Parita, Oria, and Ocú rivers.",
"Target Audience": "Population in the eastern sector of the province of Panama; users with needs related to drinking water consumption, food production, energy generation, industry, transport, recreation, ecosystems, agriculture, new uses, and urban growth.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased freshwater availability and water storage capacity; conserved water through reservoirs and rainwater harvesting; feasibility evidence for increasing water availability; preparation of studies and technical designs for a Bayano water treatment plant; reduced risk of future water shortages caused by an unpredictable climate; guaranteed availability for new uses and urban growth."
panama_PNSH_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Preventive management of water-related risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Estimate future water availability to meet future demands and take preventive measures to mitigate impacts and increase resilience to extreme events.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water management.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers in water management; people and infrastructure.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Mitigated impacts and increased resilience of people and infrastructure to extreme events."
panama_PNSH_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Mitigate the impacts of climate events, prevent them from becoming disasters, reduce the vulnerability of people and public and private water and sanitation infrastructure, maintain the country's growth levels, and protect its natural resources, including water.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop tools to identify risks, reduce their impacts, prepare for emergencies, financially protect investments, and plan for the recovery and restoration of infrastructure; diagnosis of the risk situation; implementation of the National Program for Hydrological Extremes Management; adaptation and mitigation plans, including climate change; dredging and channeling of rivers; open and underground river drainage in urban areas.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Risk management in the water and sanitation sector; rivers; urban areas; natural resources, including water.",
"Target Audience": "People; public and private water and sanitation infrastructure.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced impacts of climate events, prevention of disasters, reduced vulnerability of people and water and sanitation infrastructure, maintenance of the country's growth levels, protection of natural resources including water, and recovery and restoration of infrastructure."
panama_PNSH_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Monitor climate events and their effects, and install early-warning systems for disasters and extreme climate events.",
"Action/Intervention": "Investments for the purchase, installation, operation, and replacement of instruments necessary to monitor climate events and their effects; install early-warning systems; attention to disasters and extreme climate events; establish an early-warning system for floods and landslides in watersheds; develop an agroclimatic system for the agricultural sector; strengthen SINAPROC's Desinventar platform; install early-warning systems in schools; determine a vulnerability index and define government action thresholds for extreme events; purchase and operate hydrometeorological stations for the agricultural sector; continue operating SINAPROC's tide-monitoring system; install tide gauges; install sensors for electrical discharges; acquire a satellite-image reception station.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Climate risk monitoring and early warning; watersheds; agricultural sector; schools; tide-monitoring system.",
"Target Audience": "SINAPROC; government; agricultural sector; schools.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved monitoring of climate events and their effects; operational early-warning systems for floods, landslides, schools, and extreme climate events; strengthened Desinventar platform; vulnerability index and government action thresholds for extreme events defined; hydrometeorological stations, tide gauges, electrical discharge sensors, and a satellite-image reception station installed or operating."
panama_PNSH_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Guaranteeing water sustainability.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improving water governance; ensuring effective inter-institutional coordination; strengthening institutions so they have the technical, operational, logistical, and financial capacities necessary to exercise their mandate; establishing an adequate regulatory framework and institutional capacity to enforce it; promoting an educated society actively participating in the responsible management of water; and making the structural adjustments presented in this Plan.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water.",
"Target Audience": "Institutions with a water-related mandate, society, and all water users.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Effective inter-institutional coordination; institutions with the capacities necessary to exercise their mandate; an adequate regulatory framework and institutional capacity to enforce it; an educated society actively participating in the responsible management of water; and a level of satisfaction adequate to the needs of all water users."
panama_PNSH_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To help resolve conflicts over access to water and prevent future ones in a participatory way, and through user education and awareness on water use.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen spaces for consultation and participation (forums, meetings, agreements, information dissemination, user regularization); create and/or strengthen the operation of watershed committees; strengthen the capacities of mediators in water-resource conflict resolution; strengthen the capacities of local authorities and institutions in water-resource conflict resolution; carry out these actions continuously during the Plan's validity.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources; watersheds.",
"Target Audience": "Water users; watershed committees; mediators; local authorities; institutions.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Resolved conflicts over access to water, prevention of future water-access conflicts, strengthened consultation and participation spaces, improved operation of watershed committees, and strengthened capacities of mediators, local authorities, and institutions in water-resource conflict resolution."
panama_PNSH_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "To update regulations whose management has become obsolete in relation to the country's evolution and to fill legal gaps identified during the Plan's preparation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Review and adjust the regulatory framework during the Plan's validity; undertake short-term actions for priority regulatory reforms; disseminate the reforms; build capacity in their application; update and/or develop existing regulations.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Regulatory and legal framework under the Plan.",
"Target Audience": "Entities responsible for implementing, disseminating, and applying the regulations under the Plan.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reviewed, adjusted, updated, and/or newly developed regulations; legal gaps addressed; priority regulatory reforms disseminated; and capacity built for their application."
panama_PNSH_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Institutional strengthening to implement the PNSH.",
"Action/Intervention": "Capacity-building for current staff; incorporation of new staff with technical specializations related to the management, administration, protection, supervision, monitoring, and evaluation of the water resource; implementation of 23 projects across four areas: strengthening human-resource capacities, institutional strengthening and equipment, organization of integrated water governance (regulation, planning, operation, service provision), and creation of the Hydrological, Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Oceanographic Information Service (SIHAGO).",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resource management and integrated water governance.",
"Target Audience": "Current staff and new staff involved in the implementation of the PNSH.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Implementation of the PNSH through strengthened institutional capacity, including enhanced human-resource capacities, improved institutional strengthening and equipment, organized integrated water governance, and creation of SIHAGO."
panama_PNSH_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reinforce education, capacity-building, and information on the use, protection, and conservation of water, and support the sustainable use of water resources.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement 12 planned investment projects, including short-term investments, organized into two lines of action: training for better water use; research for better water management; and planning and training of professionals in water (identification of technical careers).",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources; use, protection, conservation, and management of water.",
"Target Audience": "Professionals in water and participants in training, education, capacity-building, and research activities coordinated within the framework of the National Strategic Plan for Science, Technology, and Innovation coordinated by SENACYT.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved education, capacity-building, information, research, and professional training related to better water use and better water management through the implementation of the planned investment projects."
